trello.name: Certificate renewal and rotation
trello.desc: Ben to renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st), deploy to the load balancers, and move it onto cert-manager for auto-renewal. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public one) in the same change window, also on cert-manager. Deadline: August 22nd.

trello.name: PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Aisha to implement PDF export for reports as a single deliverable with two halves: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome, and frontend adds the export button along with a progress state for large reports. Also record a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog as part of finishing the feature. Deadline: end of month.

trello.name: Staging parity
trello.desc: Ben to run the three pending migrations on staging today, and write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge.
